_comment: You need to download the file locally so that the evaluator can verify whether the local file and the file in the VM are exactly identical. The current evaluator is too weak.
instruction: Enable Mouse Keys as a motor accessibility aid and keep it enabled. Go to the SIRA website(https://www.sira.nsw.gov.au/), find the Allied Health Treatment Request form, download the PDF, and save it on the Desktop as `AlliedHeathTreatmentRequestForm.pdf`.
gt_steps: Turn on Mouse Keys and keep it enabled.
Navigate through the SIRA website to find the Allied Health Treatment Request form.
Open the Allied Health Treatment Request form.
Save the PDF on the Desktop as `AlliedHeathTreatmentRequestForm.pdf`.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$flags = [int](Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\MouseKeys' -Name 'Flags' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (($flags -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'MOUSE_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'MOUSE_KEYS_DISABLED' }"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$file='C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\AlliedHeathTreatmentRequestForm.pdf'; if (-not (Test-Path $file)) { Write-Output 'FILE_MISSING'; exit }; Write-Output 'FILE_EXISTS'; $txt=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'allied_health_form.txt'; pdftotext $file $txt; $content=Get-Content $txt -Raw; if ($content -match '(?i)Allied\s+Health\s+Treatment') { Write-Output 'PDF_CONTENT_CORRECT' } else { Write-Output 'PDF_CONTENT_INCORRECT' }; Remove-Item $txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
